want: to filter transactions by item text, amount range, and specific date range
soThat: I can quickly find and audit specific transactions without scrolling through the full list
acceptance: a search text field filters transactions whose item contains the query on both web and Android
amount range inputs (min and max) filter transactions whose amount falls within the range
date range inputs (from and to) filter transactions by specific dates within or across months
all advanced filters combine with the existing month, wallet, type, and category filters
clearing a filter restores the full result set with other active filters still applied
